1.7.0 shipped the components without the CSS they stand on. This release brings that CSS with them, and adds the check that would have caught it.

### 🐛 Fixed

- **The components had no box.** They read thirteen classes and seven tokens that were defined nowhere in this repository - `.bv-btn`, its four width stages, the chip and glyph forms, the reactive label, the modal entrance, and the `--btn-h` / `--btn-pad-x` / `--btn-gap` / `--btn-w-*` tokens underneath them. All of it had been living in one adopting app's own stylesheet the whole time, so a button copied out of `reference/react/` arrived with no height, no padding and no radius. Every file typechecked perfectly; the defect was only visible on screen. The rules are now in `reference/tokens.css` where the components can find them.
- **The prefix moves to `glim-`.** Those classes carried one app's own three-letter prefix into a shared folder, which would have left every adopting app with a stranger's initials in its markup. Renamed throughout, so the folder speaks the language's own name.
- **Two utilities the components used were not in the theme layer.** `bg-statusWarnBgStrong` had no token at all - an opaque warn wash for a chip sitting on a row that already carries a fill, since the translucent one takes that fill's colour through it. Added in all three colour modes. `text-accentText` was this repository's `--accent-ink` under an adopting app's older name, and now uses the name the token table already documents.
- **A toast entered from the wrong edge in right-to-left languages.** The slide distance was a literal inside the keyframes, and a keyframe cannot be mirrored by a class sweep, which is exactly why it survived an RTL pass. It is a token now, mirrored under `[dir="rtl"]`.
- **The card-wide reveal in reactive rainbow mode was missing.** Without it a heading notch lights up only while the pointer rests on its own glyph, which nobody finds.
- **Comments pointed at a file that does not exist here.** Several referenced an adopting app's `index.css` by name, and one described a CSS rule this repository never had.

### ✨ Added

- **`reference/react/check.sh`** answers the question TypeScript cannot: does every class, themed utility and custom property the components touch actually exist here? It found all of the above. The check was then broken on purpose to prove it fails - the first version passed while a class was deleted, because a plain substring match let `.glim-btn-chip` answer for a missing `.glim-btn`.
